answer: Pay agents mostly in rewards that vest over about 100 epochs, with a clawback clause. A sybil farmer must forge many identities and keep each one working for months while its earnings sit locked, a canyon between effort and cash. Any later proof that accounts share an owner, such as near-identical answers or funds routed across a bridge between them, lets jurors slash every unvested balance in the cluster at once. Because locked value grows with each clone and one detection wipes them all, splitting into fakes earns less than one honest agent.
